Workbook generation failed to populate expected cells, resulting in 'None' values across multiple data matrices.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionErrors. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected float values. For example, H12 expected 612.5 but got None, and H35 expected 4.4999 but got None. Ensure the workbook generation logic correctly maps and writes calculated values to the 'Task' worksheet.
